author: @kingflares2
text:
I do A/B/C testing for all Titles. Lets see if the Clickbait ones win again. 

Again. I can release a full rundown of how to play the team in a stage and stalling from one stream. Or you can watch 8+ hours of me doing it somewhere in my vods. I explain everything there and every card i played and why. Unlike some people. Its complex to some. But I think its straight forward how to use tawil here. You exalt and grab gauntward and util cards like chosen one on mob waves. You want to discard posse even tawil cards due to retain prepare which works on discard and keep track of your discard pile so when you redraw its only the good cards. This works e2 Tawil. You can look at the vod where I help 2 players with e2 tawil run this through hm story. 

No I do not recommend this for dtide. Too strong, too many resources.

author: @PolarDon
text:
The comp is pretty good. i've tested on h3-10, that i had not cleared without e-gnosis prior.

a few remarks - e2 Tawil with  e0-3 and +12 key wheels feels underwhelming in the keygen department due to pontos eating all arithmetica himself, so i would get Thais wheel for her

And crit-rate issues that are expected when not playing Tawil cards. I solved them by using Ryker instead of Murphy, and a few crit wheels. Caecus OE still has not crited once crit resistance be damned

Rousing anyone exept Pontos(and Caecus if he's +12) feels unnecessary, you just want to spam posse like your life depends on it
